caption:
Snowball or avalanche? Here's how to pick your debt payoff order in 25 seconds. 🌿

Both methods start the same way: pay the minimum on everything, then send every spare pound at ONE target debt.

❄️ Snowball — smallest balance first. Quick wins early, motivation that lasts. You watch debts disappear sooner.
🏔️ Avalanche — highest interest rate first. The maths favourite — you pay less interest overall.

Example: with a £350 store card at 19.9%, a £2,000 credit card at 24.9% and a £4,500 car loan at 6.9% — snowball clears the £350 first; avalanche hits the 24.9% card first.

Neither is wrong. Need wins to keep going? Snowball. Motivated by the maths? Avalanche. The best method is the one you stick to.
